Name: Froststar's Modest Greenhouse
Author: froststar11
Description:
[color=red][size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size][/color]

Underwhelmed by the boring old unevenly spaced greenhouse in the vanilla game? Don't want one of the OP megamaps offered by other mods? Feel like your farmer would have farm tools and pretty green things growing in every square inch of that greenhouse, given the chance? Give my Modest Greenhouse a try!

[size=4][u][b]Mod Highlights:[/b][/u][/size]
By default, this greenhouse will have four 5x5 dirt areas (room for 96 crops if you account for sprinklers), as well as dedicated space in a second room for you to plant an orchard (room for 12 trees; intended to hold one each of the 8 vanilla game fruit trees, and four tappable trees of your choice) and a row of trellis crops.

[i]Step 1: Install Mod. Step 2: Grow things in the greenhouse. Step 3: PROFIT. [/i]
This greenhouse also has a cellar enabled by default that you can configure or disable! No more running around between sheds, or cramming every available tile full of kegs, and storing up wine for the day when you can upgrade your farmhouse and unlock the cellar there!

[size=4][u]Highly Configurable![/u]
[/size]I really wanted to test the limits of what I could do with this mod! For the best experience, I recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod, but it is optional. If you do not want to use the GMCM to configure this mod's options, the game will generate a [i]config.json[/i] file automatically after you run it for the first time with this mod installed. You can then exit the game, and edit your config options manually in that file (See the ConfigSchema section of the [i]content.json[/i] file for your options).

Options include:
[list]
[*]Choose between four levels of permanent decorations in your greenhouse to fit your aesthetic! (full / less / minimal / no decor)
[*]Choose to disable the cellar entirely for a more balanced option
[*]Choose to disable the orchard room entirely for a more true-to-vanilla option
[*]Choose to add more plantable space to the greenhouse by replacing the center aisle with three 3x3 dirt squares
[*]Furthermore, choose if you want to wait until you've upgraded your farmhouse to unlock both cellars at the same time, or to have access from the moment you unlock the greenhouse itself!
[*]Choose to have decor in the greenhouse cellar, or leave it empty - a blank canvas for you to fill with kegs, preserve jars, and other artisan machines!
[/list]
[b][i]Default options: Greenhouse Decor (FULL), More Plantable Area (DISABLED), Orchard (ENABLED), Cellar (ENABLED) with NO House Upgrade Required, and Cellar Decor (ENABLED)[/i][/b]
[line]
[size=4][u]How To Install[/u]:[/size]

- Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Download and install the latest version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets [/url]mod
- Download and unzip the mod file
- Copy the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods 
- Load the game using SMAPI, configure your options, and enjoy!

[u][size=4]How to Uninstall:[/size][/u]

- Delete the mod folder from your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. The game will revert to the original greenhouse layout.

Please note that since this is an expansion to the size of the original greenhouse, any crops or objects left in areas outside the bounds of the vanilla greenhouse will be inaccessible without the No Clip mod after uninstalling. I recommend a full clear of crops, chests, and decor placed in the greenhouse before uninstalling to avoid unnecessary headaches like crops growing in strange places and trees hanging out in the black void.
[size=4]
[/size][u][size=4]Potential Mod Conflicts:[/size]
[/u]
This mod replaces the map for the interior of the greenhouse. Any other mods that attempt to do the same will not work with my mod. Otherwise, this mod should be conflict free.

[line]

Downloads.Description: Download this file and extract its contents. Drop the '[CP] Froststar's Modest Greenhouse' folder into your StardewValley/Mods folder, along with the Content Patcher and HxW Tilesheets mods if you do not already have them. Launch the game with SMAPI.
